name: plugin.stagehand_browser
description: Browserbase's next-generation AI browser automation engine with Act, Extract, Observe, and WebMCP protocol integration

entrypoints.name: stagehand_act
entrypoints.description: Execute high-level natural language actions (clicks, keyboard input, navigation) on active page

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Natural language command (e.g. 'click the login button')

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: LLM model name for action inference

parameters.name: timeout_s
parameters.description: Timeout for action completion in seconds

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Template variables to substitute into action

entrypoints.name: stagehand_extract
entrypoints.description: Extract structured data matching a target JSON schema directly from live DOM & rendered layout

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: Extraction goal (e.g. 'Extract all product prices and titles')

entrypoints.name: stagehand_observe
entrypoints.description: Inspect live DOM to return interactive elements, locators, and suggested next actions

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: Focus area instruction or element description

entrypoints.name: stagehand_webmcp_tool_invoke
entrypoints.description: Discover and invoke WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) tools exposed by web pages

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: WebMCP tool name to invoke (or '__list__' to enumerate all available tools)

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: Arguments dictionary passed to the WebMCP tool

entrypoints.name: stagehand_session_control
entrypoints.description: Manage browser session lifecycle, navigation, JavaScript evaluation, and page capture

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target URL when action is 'goto' or 'init'
